question: wat is the punisment for theft in bangladesh?
reference_answer: Under section 379 of the Penal Code, 1860, theft is punishable with imprisonment of either description for up to three years, or fine, or both.
gold_text:
The Penal Code, 1860 (Act No. XLV of 1860)
Section 379
379. Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.

question: how mny weeks matrnity benifit do factry women workrs get?
reference_answer: Under section 46 of the Bangladesh Labour Act, 2006, a woman worker gets maternity benefit for 8 weeks before the expected delivery date and 8 weeks after delivery, if she has worked at least six months for that employer before delivery; it is not payable if she already has two or more living children.

question: যৌতুক চাওয়ার শাস্তী কি?
reference_answer: যৌতুক নিরোধ আইন, ২০১৮-এর ধারা ৩ অনুযায়ী বিবাহের কোনো পক্ষ অন্য পক্ষের কাছে প্রত্যক্ষ বা পরোক্ষভাবে যৌতুক দাবি করলে অন্যূন এক বছর ও অনধিক পাঁচ বছর কারাদণ্ড বা অনধিক পঞ্চাশ হাজার টাকা অর্থদণ্ড বা উভয় দণ্ড হবে।

question: বাল্য বিবাহ করলে শাস্তি কি হব?

question: minimum age for marrige for girls and boys in bangldesh?

question: talak dile ki chairman ke janate hoy?
reference_answer: Yes. Under section 7 of the Muslim Family Laws Ordinance, 1961, a husband who pronounces talaq must as soon as possible give written notice to the Chairman and a copy to the wife; failing to do so is punishable with up to one year's simple imprisonment, a fine up to ten thousand taka, or both. The talaq takes effect 90 days after the notice reaches the Chairman.

question: What is the difference in punishment between theft and robbery?
reference_answer: Under the Penal Code, 1860, theft (section 379) is punishable with up to three years' imprisonment, or fine, or both, while robbery (section 392) is punishable with rigorous imprisonment up to ten years and fine, extendable to fourteen years if committed on a highway between sunset and sunrise.
gold_text:
The Penal Code, 1860 (Act No. XLV of 1860)
Section 379
379. Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.

The Penal Code, 1860 (Act No. XLV of 1860)
Section 392
392. Whoever commits robbery shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine; and, if the robbery be committed on the highway between sunset and sunrise, the imprisonment may be extended to fourteen years.

question: খুন আর খুন নয় এমন অপরাধজনক নরহত্যার শাস্তির পার্থক্য কী?
reference_answer: দণ্ডবিধি, ১৮৬০-এর ধারা ৩০২ অনুযায়ী খুনের শাস্তি মৃত্যুদণ্ড বা যাবজ্জীবন কারাদণ্ড এবং অর্থদণ্ড। ধারা ৩০৪ অনুযায়ী খুন নয় এমন অপরাধজনক নরহত্যায় মৃত্যু ঘটানোর উদ্দেশ্য থাকলে যাবজ্জীবন বা দশ বছর পর্যন্ত কারাদণ্ড ও অর্থদণ্ড; উদ্দেশ্য ছাড়া কেবল জ্ঞান থাকলে দশ বছর পর্যন্ত কারাদণ্ড বা অর্থদণ্ড বা উভয়।

question: Under the Bangladesh Labour Act, how long is maternity benefit and how is the amount calculated?
reference_answer: Under section 46 of the Bangladesh Labour Act, 2006, a woman worker gets maternity benefit for 8 weeks before and 8 weeks after delivery if she worked at least six months for the employer. Under section 48, it is paid fully in cash at her average daily, weekly or monthly wage, worked out by dividing her total wages in the three months before her notice by the days she actually worked.

question: বাল্যবিবাহে বর-কনে এবং তাদের মা-বাবার কী শাস্তি হতে পারে?
reference_answer: বাল্যবিবাহ নিরোধ আইন, ২০১৭-এর ধারা ৭ অনুযায়ী প্রাপ্তবয়স্ক কেউ বাল্যবিবাহ করলে অনধিক দুই বছর কারাদণ্ড বা অনধিক এক লক্ষ টাকা অর্থদণ্ড বা উভয়, আর অপ্রাপ্তবয়স্ক কেউ করলে অনধিক এক মাস আটকাদেশ বা পঞ্চাশ হাজার টাকা জরিমানা বা উভয়। ধারা ৮ অনুযায়ী মা-বাবা বা অভিভাবক বাল্যবিবাহ সম্পন্ন করলে, অনুমতি দিলে বা অবহেলায় বন্ধ করতে ব্যর্থ হলে অন্যূন ছয় মাস ও অনধিক দুই বছর কারাদণ্ড বা অনধিক পঞ্চাশ হাজার টাকা অর্থদণ্ড বা উভয়।

question: What must a Muslim husband do to divorce his wife, and can he marry again without permission while still married?
reference_answer: Under section 7 of the Muslim Family Laws Ordinance, 1961, after pronouncing talaq he must give written notice to the Chairman and a copy to his wife; the talaq takes effect 90 days after the notice reaches the Chairman. Under section 6, while a marriage subsists he cannot contract another marriage without the prior written permission of the Arbitration Council, and such a marriage cannot be registered without it.

question: Can police arrest someone without a warrant, and how long can they hold that person before taking them to a magistrate?
reference_answer: Under section 54 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, police may arrest without a warrant, for example a person concerned in a cognizable offence or reasonably suspected of it. Under section 61, a person arrested without a warrant cannot be held longer than reasonable, and never more than 24 hours (excluding travel time to the Magistrate's Court) without a magistrate's special order under section 167.

question: Who can claim a right of pre-emption when a co-sharer sells land, according to the Appellate Division?
reference_answer: In Abul Kasem Md. Kaiser Vs. Md. Ramjan Ali (14 SCOB [2020] AD 106) the Appellate Division held that pre-emption gives co-sharers priority over strangers when a co-sharer sells; the person claiming it must be a co-sharer in an undivided plot or parcel. Once land is separated or physically partitioned, co-sharership extends only to the portion recorded in that khatian and not separated by a new jama.
gold_text:
Abul Kasem Md. Kaiser Vs. Md. Ramjan Ali & ors.
14 SCOB [2020] AD 106 — Appellate Division (MIRZA HUSSAIN HAIDER J.)
---
27. Onreading all the statutes dealing with pre-emption, it appears that the legislature incorporated the same to provide privilege to the co-sharers over the strangers in purchasing/enjoying the land/property that has been sold out by one or more of his co- sharer(s) to stranger(s) and also to prevent the stranger(s) from coming into such co- sharership. Entrance into co-sharership is possible as long as the land remains undivided but it is not possible rather it becomes impossible as soon as such land has been separated or physically partitioned by demarcation.In such case co-sharership extends only to the portion of the plot that has been recorded in a particular Khatian and has not been separated by creating new “jama”.
28. Now,it is necessary to seewho is a “co-sharer tenant of land” and what has been meant by “co-sharer tenant in the holding”. Generally co-sharer means joint owners (in Bengali what is called “kwiKevkwiKcÖRv”).When the term is used in respect of property it means-‘a person who shares his right, title and interest with some other person(s) ina holding or plot or in an undivided share thereof’.Land in connection with section 24 of the NAT Act, appears to be a plot or a parcel of plots owned by two or more co-sharers jointly. So, in order toexercise the right of pre-emption under the aforesaid Act, the person so claimingmust be a co-sharer inan undivided plot or parcel thereof.
